title: Remove K Digits
statement: Remove exactly k digits from the number so that what remains, read in the same order, is the smallest possible. Return it as a string with no leading zeros, or "0" if everything is removed.
constraints: num has no leading zeros of its own, except the single digit "0"
the result must not have leading zeros; the empty result is "0"
hints: A digit is worth removing when a smaller digit follows it, because the earlier position carries more weight.
Sweep left to right keeping a stack that never decreases: while the top is greater than the incoming digit and removals remain, pop it.

Three loose ends decide whether this passes: unused removals at the end must come off the BACK, leading zeros need stripping afterwards, and an empty result becomes "0". Each of those has its own test here.

cases.name: already increasing, so trim the tail
